decisions.basis: ValidatorRegistry resolves the canonical SystemSafety component through IProtocolRegistry420 and rejects inactive or runtime-code-hash-mismatched dependencies.

Stake system contracts retain constructor-bound GovernanceTimelock authority through SystemAccess for governance-owned bindings and reserve administration. Consensus-owned lifecycle, slash and reward outcomes remain separately restricted to ConsensusSystemCall420.

Stake has no generic directional application route. Canonical activation and withdrawal emergency behavior is expressed by SystemSafety action classes while consensus and withdrawal-address authorization remain independent.
Validator liveness, readiness and eligibility are consensus lifecycle state. A generic HealthRegistry must not override fourtwentyd validator adjudication.
Frozen Genesis validator registration requires unique owner and BLS key, real collateral and lifecycle qualification; no Identity credential is a canonical eligibility requirement.
Stake exposes direct owner or withdrawal authority plus governance and native consensus authority. It has no delegated operational capability surface.
Frozen system-safety semantics require new activation to be NORMAL_ONLY and mature withdrawal to be WITHDRAWAL_ONLY. ValidatorRegistry enforces both through registry-resolved ISystemSafety420.
ValidatorRegistry exposes IGenesisInitializable420-compatible configuration hash, initialization status and initialization version. Exact predeploy storage materialization remains STAKE-AUDIT-7.
The frozen Stake contracts are non-proxy predeploys with no runtime migration entry point. Historical implementation and version migration is a deployment and registry provenance concern.
Validator mutations are native transactions or authenticated consensus system calls; Stake has no relayed off-chain signed-command execution path.
ConsensusSystemCall420 enforces strict sequence replay protection; ValidatorRegistry records single-use slash evidence and RewardController records single-use reward blocks.
ConsensusSystemCall420 validates chainId, block and parent for consensus writes. Direct user registration and withdrawal execute in native EVM transaction context.
ValidatorRegistry stores an opaque metadata commitment in the canonical validator record. It does not delegate validator authority or mutable metadata ownership to IMetadataCommitment420.

invariants: Governance cannot forge consensus-owned validator lifecycle, slash, rotation or reward outcomes.
A transition into ACTIVE fails closed unless registry-resolved SystemSafety permits NORMAL_ONLY activation.
Mature bond withdrawal fails closed unless registry-resolved SystemSafety permits WITHDRAWAL_ONLY execution.
SystemSafety resolution fails closed on inactive, missing or runtime-code-hash-mismatched registry entries.
Generic health, identity, pause or capability systems cannot silently become validator-consensus authority.
Genesis initialization configuration is inspectable on ValidatorRegistry; exact storage materialization is deferred only to STAKE-AUDIT-7.
Replay protection remains at the authority that owns each replay domain rather than adding a second mutable global nonce authority.

follow_up.STAKE-AUDIT-2: Preserve ConsensusSystemCall420 chain, context and sequence authority while implementing deterministic fourtwentyd lifecycle, slash, rotation and reward call derivation.
follow_up.STAKE-AUDIT-7: Materialize the exact ValidatorRegistry ProtocolRegistry binding and genesisConfigHash in deterministic frozen predeploy storage.
